the mansion staff's party drinks in 1933

Spicy ginger beer with fresh orange juice, lime and mint, served from a punch bowl over plenty of ice. In a large jug, combine 400ml orange juice, 60ml lime juice and a handful of torn mint. Add ice, then pour in 800ml chilled ginger beer and stir gently. Add orange slices and serve in glasses with a mint sprig.

s.note: Chicken and mushroom vol-au-vents with prosciutto asparagus
s.how: Bake 16 vol-au-vent cases until crisp. Fry 250g diced chicken thigh and 150g mushrooms, add 150ml cream and thyme and reduce. Fill the cases. Blanch 2 bunches asparagus and wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

s.note: Buttery salted popcorn in paper cones
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, and when they pop add 120g kernels, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter and fine salt while hot. Roll paper into cones and fill them up.

m.note: Tarragon butter roast chicken with gravy, potatoes and peas
m.how: Dry-brine a 1.8kg chicken overnight. Push 60g butter mixed with chopped tarragon under the skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C until the thigh hits 72C, with 1kg potatoes. Make gravy with 250ml stock. Serve with buttered peas.

w.note: Hot fudge sundaes with cream, almonds and a cherry
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup into a hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream, toasted flaked almonds and a cherry.
